aiSummary.oneLiner: Comprehensive browser extension for enhancing the Meccha Japan shopping experience.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Meccha Enhancement Pro is a browser extension designed to optimize and streamline purchasing workflows on the Meccha Japan e-commerce platform. It injects custom JavaScript to provide real-time currency conversion, historical price tracking, and automated stock alerts. The extension also restructures the DOM to hide visual clutter and surface important shipping and availability data directly on product search pages. This tooling significantly improves the efficiency of collectors and international buyers sourcing products from the site.
keyFeatures: Currency conversion: Provides real-time, accurate currency conversion across all product listings.
Price tracking: Logs historical price changes to help users identify genuine sales and markups.
Stock alerts: Monitors specific item pages and provides browser notifications when out-of-stock items return.
UI optimization: Restructures the product pages to prioritize crucial shipping and availability information.
Batch actions: Allows users to quickly add multiple items to their cart from search result pages.

useCases.title: Efficient browsing

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: International shoppers and collectors who frequently use the Meccha Japan platform. It requires a modern web browser that supports standard extensions.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Install the extension directly from the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons site.
